conventions.evidence: Uses #[Validate] (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:29-40), policies via $this->authorize, a reversible generated-style migration, deliberate fillable, and updated docs (docs/*.md, CHANGELOG.md). Deviations: domain writes stay in the components rather than app/Actions (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:104-123, app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:38-47) and invitee authorization is a manual abort_if instead of a policy (app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:94-99).

security.evidence: Public actions resolve the record and authorize server-side (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:57,146,161,174,218; app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:19,64), with removeMember retaining its existing delete policy (tests/Feature/Entity/MembersTest.php:420-433); input is validated/normalized (Members.php:29-40,62; PendingInvites.php:82,94-99), queries are entity/e-mail scoped, and Blade uses {{ }} auto-escaping. Gap: selectedMembershipId is a client-writable record ID without #[Locked] (Members.php:35-40), mitigated by entity-scoped lookups in render/saveRole.

tests.evidence: Broad Pest coverage: schema/factory/normalization/pending (tests/Feature/Entity/EntityInviteTest.php:12-76), invite validation/duplicates/expiry/rate limit/cancel (tests/Feature/Entity/MembersTest.php:1-233), modals/roles/removal (MembersTest.php:274-433), accept/decline/403/expiry/idempotency plus onboarding and switcher rendering (tests/Feature/Entity/PendingInvitesTest.php:1-171), and the mail in both locales (tests/Feature/EntityInviteMailTest.php:1-51). Gaps: the employee component test swallows any Throwable (MembersTest.php:247-252), and there is no test for removeMember's last-manager rule or the unique-constraint race path.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses existing x-input/x-label components and the policy/audit patterns; no service layer or speculative abstraction. Minor redundancy: e-mail is normalized both in booted() and the mutator (app/Models/EntityInvite.php:36-53), and scopeAccepted()/the factory accepted() state are unused (app/Models/EntityInvite.php:76; database/factories/EntityInviteFactory.php:39-44).

readability.evidence: Clear names and focused methods in app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:57-143 and app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:15-99, consistent with sibling Livewire and Blade style. sendInvite is long but linear; the new table headers rely on the unverified ui.name/ui.email keys (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:85-86).

scope.evidence: Most of the diff serves the task, but it also adds unrelated CI/deploy workflows (.github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:1-48, .github/workflows/tests.yml:1-24), including a deploy job that triggers on push to main/master.

issues.explanation: Two new CI/deploy workflows are unrelated to invite-only membership; deploy-dev.yml triggers on push to main/master and would deploy the application, so this is more than a cosmetic scope leak.
Invite creation, membership creation and invite deletion are domain writes implemented inline instead of through app/Actions/*, contrary to the project convention.
Invitee authorization is a manual e-mail abort_if rather than a policy/gate, although the convention requires authorization through policies.

selectedMembershipId (a record ID) and confirmingRemoval are public client-writable properties without #[Locked]; scoped lookups prevent a cross-entity leak, but the Livewire hardening rule is not met.
The employee component test wraps Livewire::test in try/catch(Throwable) and never asserts a 403, so it passes even if the guard is removed.

The old last-manager removal test was deleted and no replacement covers removeMember's 'never the last manager' rule; there is also no action-level unauthorized test for sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole and no test for the unique-constraint race error.
The new error strings 'This user already belongs to the team.' and 'This user has already been invited to the team.' have no pt_BR entries in lang/pt_BR.json:2-12, so Portuguese users see English.
The view now uses ui.email/ui.name, but the change only adds ui.role (lang/en/ui.php:90); if those keys are not already defined, the labels render literally as 'ui.email'/'ui.name'.
accept() sets the expired-invite error on key 'invite' (app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:27) but the view has no @error('invite'), so the invitee gets no visible feedback.
E-mail normalization is duplicated in booted() and setEmailAttribute, and scopeAccepted()/the factory accepted() state are unused.

review.summary: The change implements invite-only entity membership end to end: schema/model/factory, queued localized mail, invite sending with duplicate and rate-limit handling, pending-invite accept/decline on the switcher and onboarding, and a manager-only members page with detail and removal modals, backed by a broad Pest suite. It still needs changes before merge because it adds unrelated deploy/CI workflows, leaves authorization and removal paths untested, and has i18n/UI gaps (missing pt_BR error strings, an unrendered expired-invite error, and possibly undefined ui.name/ui.email keys). Confidence is medium because the diff does not include the pre-existing x-input and UserRole sources the new views rely on.
